g.text: Moving an old profile: start-up's step 4 (migrate.rs)
if a migration's folder is left:
remove its plan, then the folder
read the plan: the same actions
an old profile with a signature file?
create every folder the moves need,
move each item: link the new name and sync,
then unlink the old one and sync
(across file systems: copy, sync, read back, compare)
rename each cache shard into cache/content/,
remove the old folders the moves emptied
(keys/, exports/, store/, logs/, cache/): only an empty
folder can go. M7's write syncs the old folder
write MIGRATED.txt into the old folder
remove the plan, then its folder
Both are kept, and MIGRATED.txt names it.
(M2 to M5): the session only reads,
and the next start resumes the plan; finished steps
: the next start runs the barrier
(there is no marker yet), then resumes the plan.
